items.Sentence: Wastewater is treated in two clay-lined, mechanically aerated ponds (hereafter “Pond 1” and “Pond 2”). Wastewater is treated by partial-mix facultative (aerobic-anaerobic) stabilization.
Wastewater is disposed of through a percolation pond (hereafter “Pond 3”) in series.
In 2009, Pond 4 was taken off-line, dried, deep ripped, and disked to improve percolation.
